concepts.def: Saying a word/phrase again in unplanned talk
Hesitations and pauses in real speech

walkthroughs.body_html: Unlike writing, talk has fillers, restarts and pauses — and that's totally normal.

Fillers: 'um', 'er', 'erm', 'like'.

False start: 'I was going to — well, actually I went...'

These give us thinking time.

'Right, so anyway...' — these little words flag a topic change, opening or closing.

They're the traffic signs of conversation.
